# Divider

A 1px line in the border colour, optionally with grey text centred on it. The checkout puts “OR” between express checkout and the form.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/divider)

## Usage

```tsx
<Divider>OR</Divider>
<Divider />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Label centred on the line. Leave out for a plain line. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Divider.module.css`
- `Divider.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
